name: Ferengi travelling traders
description: Persistent Ferengi traders, data-only roster provisioning, encounter offers, relationship history, acceptance, rejection, and expiry

tests.name: Setup trader test player
Ensure named Ferengi trader ships exist
Install isolated Ferengi homeworld fixture required by NPC initialization

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets (planet_id, num, sector_id, name, owner_id, owner_type, class, created_by) SELECT 2, 1, 11, 'Ferengi Test Homeworld', c.corporation_id, 'corp', 'M', p.player_id FROM corporations c CROSS JOIN players p WHERE c.tag = 'FENG' AND p.name = 'System' ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET sector_id = EXCLUDED.sector_id, name = EXCLUDED.name, owner_id = EXCLUDED.owner_id, owner_type = EXCLUDED.owner_type, created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by;

tests.name: Provision travelling traders now the homeworld fixture exists
Move test player into Gaila's sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = (SELECT s.sector_id FROM ferengi_traders ft JOIN ships s USING (ship_id) WHERE ft.trader_code = 'gaila'), credits = 100000 WHERE player_id = @{ferengi_trader_test_player_id};

tests.name: Move test ship into Gaila's sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = (SELECT s.sector_id FROM ferengi_traders ft JOIN ships s USING (ship_id) WHERE ft.trader_code = 'gaila') WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{ferengi_trader_test_player_id});

tests.name: Clear test player ORE cargo

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'ORE', 0 FROM players WHERE player_id = @{ferengi_trader_test_player_id} ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 0;

tests.name: Reset test player's previous Gaila relationship

data.sql: DELETE FROM ferengi_player_relationships WHERE player_id = @{ferengi_trader_test_player_id} AND ferengi_trader_id = (SELECT ferengi_trader_id FROM ferengi_traders WHERE trader_code = 'gaila');

tests.name: Reset test player's previous Gaila relationship and open offers

data.sql: DELETE FROM ferengi_trader_interactions WHERE player_id = @{ferengi_trader_test_player_id} AND ferengi_trader_id = (SELECT ferengi_trader_id FROM ferengi_traders WHERE trader_code = 'gaila');

tests.name: Reset Gaila's open offers for this player

data.sql: DELETE FROM ferengi_trader_deals WHERE player_id = @{ferengi_trader_test_player_id} AND ferengi_trader_id = (SELECT ferengi_trader_id FROM ferengi_traders WHERE trader_code = 'gaila') AND status = 'open';

tests.name: Reset Gaila's test inventory

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'ORE', 30 FROM ferengi_traders WHERE trader_code = 'gaila' ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 30;

tests.name: Refresh player sector context
Encounter returns a persistent named trader and offer
NPC visit creates a persistent encounter offer
Offer remains visible after the trader moves away
Save the generated offer ID

data.sql: SELECT ferengi_trader_deal_id FROM ferengi_trader_deals WHERE player_id = @{ferengi_trader_test_player_id} AND ferengi_trader_id = (SELECT ferengi_trader_id FROM ferengi_traders WHERE trader_code = 'gaila') AND idempotency_key LIKE 'visit:%' ORDER BY ferengi_trader_deal_id DESC LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Accept trader offer settles cargo and records relationship
Repeated acceptance returns remembered settled deal
Reject subsequent trader offer

data.sql: INSERT INTO ferengi_trader_deals (ferengi_trader_deal_id, ferengi_trader_id, player_id, commodity_code, side, quantity, unit_price, status, idempotency_key, expires_at) SELECT 889100002, ferengi_trader_id, @{ferengi_trader_test_player_id}, 'ORE', 'trader_buys', 1, 5, 'open', 'integration-reject-889100002', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 hour' FROM ferengi_traders WHERE trader_code = 'gaila' ON CONFLICT (ferengi_trader_deal_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'open', expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 hour';

tests.name: Reject records remembered refusal
Expired deal is not accepted

data.sql: INSERT INTO ferengi_trader_deals (ferengi_trader_deal_id, ferengi_trader_id, player_id, commodity_code, side, quantity, unit_price, status, idempotency_key, created_at, expires_at) SELECT 889100003, ferengi_trader_id, @{ferengi_trader_test_player_id}, 'ORE', 'trader_sells', 1, 5, 'open', 'integration-expire-889100003', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 hour', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 second' FROM ferengi_traders WHERE trader_code = 'gaila' ON CONFLICT (ferengi_trader_deal_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'open', created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 hour', expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 second';

tests.name: Fixture another expired offer for cron cleanup

data.sql: INSERT INTO ferengi_trader_deals (ferengi_trader_deal_id, ferengi_trader_id, player_id, commodity_code, side, quantity, unit_price, status, idempotency_key, created_at, expires_at) SELECT 889100004, ferengi_trader_id, @{ferengi_trader_test_player_id}, 'ORE', 'trader_sells', 1, 5, 'open', 'integration-cron-expire-889100004', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 hour', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 second' FROM ferengi_traders WHERE trader_code = 'gaila' ON CONFLICT (ferengi_trader_deal_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'open', created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 hour', expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 second';

tests.name: NPC cron expires old trader deals
Verify cron expiry is durable

data.sql: SELECT status FROM ferengi_trader_deals WHERE ferengi_trader_deal_id = 889100004;

tests.name: Expired offer transitions on player action
Remembered interaction rows survive offer lifecycle

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 3 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END FROM ferengi_trader_interactions WHERE player_id = @{ferengi_trader_test_player_id} AND ferengi_trader_id = (SELECT ferengi_trader_id FROM ferengi_traders WHERE trader_code = 'gaila');

tests.name: Clean up interrupted data-only trader fixture

data.sql: DELETE FROM ships WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM ferengi_traders WHERE trader_code = 'codex_fixture_roster_only');

tests.name: Clean up interrupted trader definition

data.sql: DELETE FROM ferengi_trader_definitions WHERE trader_code = 'codex_fixture_roster_only';

tests.name: Add temporary trader using data only

data.sql: INSERT INTO ferengi_trader_definitions (trader_code, display_name, ship_type_id, active) SELECT 'codex_fixture_roster_only', 'Configured Roster Trader', shiptypes_id, TRUE FROM shiptypes WHERE name = 'Merchant Freighter' ON CONFLICT (trader_code) DO UPDATE SET active = TRUE, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, ship_type_id = EXCLUDED.ship_type_id;

tests.name: Configure temporary trader commodity rotation

data.sql: INSERT INTO ferengi_trader_definition_rotation (trader_code, position, commodity_code) VALUES ('codex_fixture_roster_only', 1, 'ORE') ON CONFLICT (trader_code, position) DO UPDATE SET commodity_code = EXCLUDED.commodity_code;

tests.name: Configure temporary trader starting cargo

data.sql: INSERT INTO ferengi_trader_definition_cargo (trader_code, commodity_code, quantity) VALUES ('codex_fixture_roster_only', 'ORE', 3) ON CONFLICT (trader_code, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

tests.name: NPC tick provisions the configured trader
Verify data-only trader was provisioned with its configured name

data.sql: SELECT display_name FROM ferengi_traders WHERE trader_code = 'codex_fixture_roster_only';

tests.name: Remove temporary data-only trader

data.sql: DELETE FROM ships WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM ferengi_traders WHERE trader_code = 'codex_fixture_roster_only');

tests.name: Remove temporary trader definition

data.sql: DELETE FROM ferengi_trader_definitions WHERE trader_code = 'codex_fixture_roster_only';
